lead: A `dossier:` floor check naming a feature that owes *every* proof can be a renamed heading rather than unwritten work.
body: The roster is derived from the reference chapters, so `# Closures` becoming `` # Closures: `fn` `` renamed the feature id and orphaned five proofs a goal had just landed. List the proof trees for the neighbouring ids and `git log -3` the chapter before writing anything: a rename is repaired with `git mv`, the `covers:` markers and one `--record-perf`.
